notes.author: David Revoy <https://framagit.org/Deevad>
text: Hi! A quick note: this episode is an obvious metaphor of the voting system proposed by any website on the internet; we 'like', 'downvote', 'upvote' and all of this in realtime. This system affects the content a lot. Our witches here discover the power of the 'cute witches' effect; a parody of a growing trend I see everywhere in anime culture nowaday, but also the load of 'sexy' content I see in digital art to get more 'likes' and 'upvotes' in general... Denunciating this practice with humor wasn't evident, but it was fun to try. :-) I hope you liked this episode!
